# orca correction

Every `orca correction` command. Ids: a full id, a unique prefix, or (projects) a name or path.

## `orca correction list`

every recorded correction, its debug groups and closed state

- What it does: reads from the panel (no write).
- Who may: open over the socket (a flag marked human-only still needs a person token).

## `orca correction record [--decision <decision>] [--run <run>] --kind <kind> --because <because> [--chose-instead <chose-instead>] [--again]`

record a correction of a decision, a run (--run) or, with neither, the project

- What it does: sends control verb `correction-record`.
- Who may: open over the socket (a flag marked human-only still needs a person token).
- `--decision <decision>`: <run-id>/<n>
- `--run <run>`: a finished run's id (instead of --decision)
- `--kind <kind>` (required): wrong|not_my_taste|stale
- `--because <because>` (required): why
- `--chose-instead <chose-instead>`: what was chosen instead
- `--again`: record it although the decision has a correction already

## `orca correction close <correction> --undo-how <undo-how> [--chose-instead <chose-instead>] [--undo-cost <undo-cost>] [--undo-blast-radius <undo-blast-radius>]`

close a correction by hand with its undo.how

- What it does: sends control verb `correction-close`.
- Who may: open over the socket (a flag marked human-only still needs a person token).
- `<correction>`: a correction id (c_ + 16 hex)
- `--undo-how <undo-how>` (required): the executable undo
- `--chose-instead <chose-instead>`: what was chosen instead
- `--undo-cost <undo-cost>`: the undo's cost
- `--undo-blast-radius <undo-blast-radius>`: the undo's blast radius

## `orca correction withdraw <correction>`

withdraw a correction

- What it does: sends control verb `correction-withdraw`.
- Who may: open over the socket (a flag marked human-only still needs a person token).
- `<correction>`: a correction id (c_ + 16 hex)

## `orca correction debug <correction> [--reopen] [--check <check>] [--undo-how <undo-how>]`

open the correction's debug group (spends nothing); --reopen for the next one

- What it does: sends control verb `correction-debug-open`.
- Who may: open over the socket (a flag marked human-only still needs a person token).
- `<correction>`: a correction id (c_ + 16 hex)
- `--reopen`: open the next debug group once the newest is stopped or archived
- `--check <check>` (repeatable): a check the debug task is held to (repeatable)
- `--undo-how <undo-how>`: the owner's undo.how for the closing row
